title: Technology Sector Update for 01/04/2019: GOOG,GOOGL,QCOM,AAPL
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT +5.08%

GOOG +5.16%
Technology stocks continue to rebound from Thursday's thrashing, with the shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 adding 4.5% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising 4.6%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Alphabet (GOOG,GOOGL) climbed 5% on Friday after the internet conglomerate said its Verily life sciences company raised $1 billion in a new funding round led by Silver Lake Ventures.
In other sector news:
(+) Qualcomm ( QCOM ) was 1.6% higher Friday afternoon after the mobile phones chipmaker asked a German court to enforce an order banning the sale of Apple (APPL) iPhones in that country amid a protracted patent dispute, media reported.
